title: Each fee payment locks the fee recipient again
rootCause: ShareManager.mint applies the targeted lockup to every recipient, the fee recipient included, so each fee mint pushes that account's lock forward and anyone who can cause a mint keeps its shares locked.

poc.observable: test_each_fee_payment_leaves_the_recipient_free_to_move_its_shares fails with "the lock on the recipient after a fee payment: 1734128000 != 0"
